properties.description: The increment that answered a field report by fixing its class. A user reported two fields their tools would not take; the root-cause pass found six constructors that could not say what the thing they made IS, and a reachability instrument that structurally could not see them. Ships: record_finding (the moment a cause is written becomes a tool call, and the tool demands the root-cause skill by name), the reachability instrument unfused and wired into CI as a regression gate, description on six constructors plus checksum on the epoch pair and priority on add_requirement, and the design-record work — Anthony's five rulings, the triage of all 46 overtaken defect records, and the field-feedback triage itself.
properties.name: v0.52.0 cut — the vocabulary the surface could not write
